sections.title: Failure to Communicate (SNF Paideia Program Course)
sections.description: This seminar examines “failure to communicate” in a variety of cultural areas, among them literature, romance, politics, theater, law, science, war, and education. Materials will include literary fiction, plays, poetry, film, TV, and assorted nonfiction, journalism and scholarship. See the English Department's website at www.english.upenn.edu for a description of the current offerings.
